question: Which exact attention-head and MLP weight tensors write into, or read from, the temporal Q8 and cross-fitted is-was physical command subspaces in their shared final-residual gauge?

novelty.closest_art: The v15 normalized reader atlas measures activation-conditioned suffix readers of a task-specific rank-two response. Earlier weight translation ranks one four-head intervention. Neither consumes physically stored temporal and is-was bases in one gauge or enumerates exact writer and reader energy for both tasks across all 18 layers.
novelty.new_object: A complete, gauge-invariant exact-weight interface atlas over the common physical ambient space, with fold-stable is-was scores, temporal scores, shared-interface classification, and literal tensor labels.

frozen_design.eligibility: Run only after a mechanically valid common-final-gauge basis result. Consume temporal_q8 and both v15 fold bases exactly as stored; do not rotate, refit, select, or average the is-was folds.
frozen_design.writer_inventory: For every layer 0--17: nine attention output slices c_proj.weight[:,128h:128(h+1)] and one MLP Down.weight, 180 interfaces total.
frozen_design.reader_inventory: For every layer 0--17: each of c_q,c_k,c_q2,c_k2,c_v weight rows [128h:128(h+1)] for all nine heads plus MLP Left.weight and Right.weight, 846 interfaces total.
frozen_design.scores: For orthonormal rank-r basis Q in R^1152, writer fraction is ||Q^T W||_F^2/||W||_F^2 and reader fraction is ||W Q||_F^2/||W||_F^2. Enrichment divides either fraction by r/1152. Report temporal, v15-fold0, and v15-fold1 fractions and enrichments for every fixed interface.
frozen_design.stability: For reader and writer inventories separately, compare v15 fold top-20 label sets by Jaccard intersection-over-union. A fold-stable is-was interface has enrichment >=4 in both folds. A shared material interface also has temporal enrichment >=4. No top-k label is discarded after outcomes.

predictions.pred_a_authority_basis_config_finiteness: The basis authority, float32 hashes/roundtrip, exact bilin18 configuration, all 1026 labels, finite scores, analytical fraction bounds, and literal price pass.
predictions.pred_b_iswas_top_weight_interfaces_are_f: Both reader and writer top-20 fold Jaccards are >=.60.
predictions.pred_c_at_least_one_fold_stable_iswas_re: At least one reader and one writer have enrichment >=4 in both v15 folds.
predictions.pred_d_at_least_one_weight_interface_is_: At least one reader or writer has temporal enrichment >=4 and v15 enrichment >=4 in both folds.

decision: A failure is invalid. B/C/D passing exposes exact shared weight-interface candidates for a preregistered causal reader/writer test. B/C pass with D failure identifies task-typed weight interfaces rather than shared use. B failure forbids naming one is-was weight route from these bases. This atlas alone never establishes causal reading or writing.
